messages:
Alex: Quick kickoff — SOC2 evidence sprint for KMS/HSM + audit logs. Goal: map dependencies, confirm owners, and surface blockers. Please add your owner status (ready/stub/missing) and any ETA. TL;DR: we need a dep matrix by EOD Tue and pre-fieldwork smoke by Thu.

Maria: I can own keystore (KMS) evidence and do the staging smoke. Will mark status as 'stub' for now — need the staging creds. @Devon can you confirm tunnel/ingress? :wave:

Devon: Yep, staging ingress is ready. I pushed a small PR for the ingest-sidebackfill: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-ingest/pull/482 — running backfill job now, ETA Wed morning.

Sam: Who's the owner for key rotation proof (envelope keys + rotation logs)? I thought that was eng-platform but happy to help coordinate.

Linh: I can take vendor attestation / HSM attestation traces. Reaching out to vendor contact today to get the attestation package and dates. Current status: 'missing' until they send it.

Jordan: Added a starter dep matrix sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example — please add rows: component, owner, status, evidence-link, blocker. Tag @Maria @Devon where relevant.

Maria: Added keystore row and put staging smoke notes. Need KMS staging creds from infra (Devon) and KMS auditlog query sample (Devon/Sam).

Devon: Sample auditlog query (Cloud logging) to grab envelope key rotation events:
```
resource.type="k8s_cluster"
logName="projects/redwood-prod/logs/kms-audit"
jsonPayload.event_type="ENVELOPE_KEY_ROTATION"
jsonPayload.request_id=~"^rot-"
```
Use timeframe +-7d to start. I also linked the backfill job logs in the PR.

security-bot: Reminder: fieldwork window opens 2026-04-12. Please ensure high-value evidence is collected and accessible by 2026-04-09.

Sam: Thanks. @Devon — can you also add a query that shows who triggered rotation (service account) and the corresponding commit/PR? That helps auditors trace intent.

Devon: Yep will add. For the commit linking we'll need to map request_id -> deploy metadata; I'll add that mapping to the dep matrix under 'evidence-link'.

Alex: One ask on prioritization — make the keystore, rotation logs, and attestations top priority. Everything else can be 'nice-to-have' for this sprint. If you need reviewer bandwidth for PRs, ping me or @Jordan. :thumbsup:

Jordan: I'll do review rotations for PRs Monday morning. Also can help triage evidence attachment formats (PDF vs ZIP vs GCS link).

Maria: Small ask — is it ok to redact service account tokens from screenshots? Auditors asked for a scrubbed artefact format.

Alex: Yes redact secrets, include metadata (timestamps, request ids, service account id) in a separate text file. Auditors prefer auditable metadata with redaction.

Linh: Vendor replied — expecting attestation PDF by Fri. I'll upload to the sheet when received and mark status 'stub'->'ready'.

Sam: I'll own rotation-proof packaging (logs + commit mapping). Putting a stub folder in GCS: gs://redwood-evidence/soc2/rotation-proof/stub/ and will move to final once PRs are linked.

Devon: Backfill job succeeded for 90% of windows, a handful of partitions failed with 429s — requeueing overnight. Will update PR with final counts.

Alex: Great. Action items recap: 1) All — update dep matrix by EOD Tue. 2) Maria — staging smoke and evidence upload. 3) Devon — add commit->request_id mapping and finalize backfill. 4) Linh — vendor attestation PDF. 5) Sam — package rotation proof into GCS and link. 6) Jordan — PR reviews Monday.

Jordan: Noted. I'll follow up with an invite thread for a 30m async review on Mon if needed.

Maria: Will do. Thanks everyone. :eyes:

Alex: Thanks — looping back after sheet is populated. If anyone hits blockers DM me.
